title: Committee Hearings & Witness-Slip Feed
description: Aggregate document produced by actions/scrape-hearings and consumed by docs/src/dashboard/index.html. One document holds the upcoming committee hearings for every supported jurisdiction, the bills each hearing covers, and (best-effort) witness-slip counts. Unlike the bill dataset this is not point-in-time bill metadata — it is a rolling window of near-future committee activity, refreshed by the Pages deploy (twice daily).

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp when this document was built (data-lineage marker for the dashboard 'as of' badge).

source.description: Human-readable provenance shown in the dashboard footer.

jurisdictions.description: Jurisdictions whose hearings this document covers, with the citizen-participation portal for filing.

code.description: Jurisdiction code: two letters for a state (il, wa), us for federal comment periods, usa for Congress's committee hearings, three for a city (chi).

participation.description: How the public weighs in on a hearing in this jurisdiction (the kinds in site/participation.json).

portal_url.description: Official portal where a resident files a slip / signs in / comments.

how_to.description: How the public takes part, for places not in site/participation.json (e.g. U.S. Congress).

open_total.description: Federal only: how many rules are open for comment in all; the document carries just the 7 closing soonest.

full_list_url.description: The official list behind the page's "See all" button: federal, the Federal Register's rules open for comment; Chicago, the City Clerk's meeting list.

notice_total.description: Federal only: how many notices (non-rule announcements) are open for comment in all.

notice_list_url.description: Federal only: the official Federal Register list of every notice open for comment.

notice_categories.description: Federal only: the notice kinds present, in display order, each with its full count (the document carries only the 2 closing soonest of each).

counts.description: Hearing count per jurisdiction code (convenience for the dashboard).

id.description: Stable identifier: <jurisdiction>-<chamber>-<committeeId>-<hearingId> (IL) or wa-<chamber>-<agendaId> (WA); <code>-os-<12 hex> for places read by Open States' meeting scrapers (from the source's own id, else its meeting page + name + start). Idempotent across runs.

chamber.description: "federal" for a Federal Register comment period.

title.description: Subject matter / agenda line as published.

scheduled_iso.description: Local wall-clock start time as naive ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS), no offset applied. Pair with `timezone` for display. Null when the source time was unparseable. Sort within a jurisdiction lexicographically.

scheduled_display.description: Source-formatted start time string for direct display.

timezone.description: IANA tz name the local time is in (e.g. America/Chicago); null for a federal comment deadline, which is a date only.

status.description: Canceled hearings are kept (they close a slip window) but flagged; "open" is a federal comment period still taking comments.

bills.description: Bills on the agenda for this hearing.

id.description: Compact bill id, e.g. HB1643, SB25.

url.description: Official page for this bill (IL: Bill Status; WA: bill summary). Null when none resolves; the page then links the hearing's details_url.

title.description: Bill/measure name from the hearing source itself, shown beside the number when the bill isn't in govbot's dataset (e.g. the MA agenda title, the federal docket title).

govbot_title.description: Bill title from govbot's own dataset, when govbot tracks this bill (build-time enrichment).

govbot_tags.description: govbot topic tags for this bill, when tracked.

slips.description: Best-effort aggregate witness-slip counts. Null/absent is the common case — many capitols only expose counts while a slip window is open, so consumers must treat this as optional.

calendar_url.description: Only when the hearing has no page of its own: the official calendar or schedule it was listed on, shown as its source.

category.description: Federal notices only: the plain-language kind of notice (see NOTICE_CATEGORIES in actions/scrape-hearings/main.py). Rules carry none.

witness_slip_url.description: Where to take part in this exact hearing: IL the first bill's Bill Status page (its Witness Slips button), else the hearing page; WA Committee Sign-In opened on this meeting; MA the hearing page (its testimony form); federal the rule's Regulations.gov comment form, else its Federal Register page. Null when there is no per-hearing way to take part (a WA interim work session; Alaska, whose only tool is its general POMS form) — the dashboard then links details_url. Chicago: the meeting's Notice PDF, which names where to send written comments.

comment_deadline.description: Chicago only: the written public comment deadline as published, as naive local ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS) in the hearing's timezone.

source.description: Origin host, e.g. ilga.gov or leg.wa.gov.
